messages.author: 1fb54f491646a589
messages.subject: Re: Repeated transects - same day
parts:
Carlos, you cannot treat the lines as replicates in such a design, nor can =
you treat a repeat run of the same transect as a separate line. In the lat=
ter case, you can record effort as line length multiplied by the number of =
times the line was covered, and pool the data on detections. In the former=
case, your inference is really restricted to the strips you surveyed - you=
don't have a basis for extrapolating density to a wider area. These issue=
s are covered in the introduction to distance sampling book.

Steve Buckland
